key: When it hears festive music, all its cells become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
en: When it hears festive music, all its cells become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
ja: ようきなリズムにあわせて体をうごかすことでパワーをぞうふくさせているのだ。

key: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
en: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
ja: 頭のさきをえだにくっつけてぶら下がる。きょうふうにあおられおちてしまうこともあるのだ。

key: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
en: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
ja: コノハナのふくくさぶえのおとはきいたものをふあんにさせる。たいぼくにあいたあなでくらす。

key: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest without people.
en: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest without people.
ja: もりのおくでひっそりとくらす。おおきなうちわをあおぐとこがらしがふくといわれている。

key: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
en: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
ja: すだちをおえたばかりなのでよるになるとさみしくなってないてしまうこともある。もりにすむケムッソをつかまえてたべる。

key: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
en: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
ja: ツヤのあるはねのていれはおこたらない。オオスバメが２ひきあつまると必ずおたがいのはねをきれいにていれするぞ。

key: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
en: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
ja: うみべのがけにすをつくる。だいこうぶつのヨワシをさがしうみのうえをせんかいしている。

key: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
en: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
ja: おおきなクチバシでヨワシをすくってまるのみにする。１どで３０ぴきいじょうをたいらげるぞ。

key: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
en: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
ja: あかいツノでひとやポケモンのあたたかなきもちをキャッチするとぜんしんがほのかにあつくなる。

key: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
en: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
ja: サイコパワーをあやつり周りのくうかんをねじまげることでみらいをみとおすことができる。

key: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.
en: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.
ja: トレーナーを守るためならサイコパワーをつかいきりちいさなブラックホールをつくりだす。

key: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
en: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
ja: みずくさの多いいけやぬまにすむ。せいそくちもくうエサもちかいシズクモとよくあらそう。

key: It intimidates foes with the eyelike patterns on its antennae. Since it can't fly with wet wings, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
en: It intimidates foes with the eyelike patterns on its antennae. Since it can't fly with wet wings, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
ja: うすいハネのようなしょっかくはしっけをすいやすい。雨のひはきのウロなどでじっとすごす。

key: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.
en: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.
ja: きけんをかんじると体をふるわせて頭のてっぺんからほうしをばらまくぞ。くさきもしおれてしまうほどのもうどくだ。

key: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
en: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
ja: シッポのタネはどくのほうしがかたまってできたものなのでたべたらたいへんだ。ひとくちでおなかがグルグルなりだすぞ。

key: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
en: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
ja: しんぞうのこどうは１ぷんかんに１かい。とにかくじっとねそべっているポケモンでうごく姿をみることはほとんどない。

key: It can't keep still because its filled with energy. It runs through fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.
en: It can't keep still because its filled with energy. It runs through fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.
ja: じっとしていることができないポケモンだ。ねむろうとしても体のちがたぎってしまいもりじゅうをかけまわらないとおさまらない。

key: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
en: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
ja: そうげんにきざまれたはんけい１メートルのわっかはケッキングがねそべったまま周りのくさをたべつくしてできたものだ。

key: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
en: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
ja: １０ねんいじょうつちのなかでくらすこともある。じゅもくのねっこからえいようをすいとる。

key: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
en: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
ja: どんな攻撃でもよけてしまうといわれるほどすばやいポケモン。あまいじゅえきがだいこうぶつ。

key: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
en: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
ja: ハネをうごかさずにとびまわる。体のなかはからっぽでいきをしないふしぎなポケモン。

key: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
en: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
ja: なきはじめると自分のこえにおどろいてさらにはげしくなく。なきつかれると眠ってしまう。

key: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
en: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
ja: おおごえはちょうかくだけでなくくうきのあつりょくとなりてきをふきとばしダメージを与える。

key: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
en: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
ja: おおごえだけじゃない。体のあなからいろいろなねいろをだしなかまといしそつうをするのだ。

key: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.
en: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.
ja: 強いマクノシタをそだてるためにトレーナーたちがでんとうてきにつくるナベりょうりがあるという。

key: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to test its strength. It has been known to stop trains using forearm thrusts.
en: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to test its strength. It has been known to stop trains using forearm thrusts.
ja: ふとっておおきなハリテヤマが強いとはかぎらない。こがらでもみがるでわざにたけたものもいる。

key: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
en: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
ja: おとなしいポケモンだがおこるとしっぽのおおきなたまをぶんぶんふりまわしてたたきつけてくるぞ。

key: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
en: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
ja: きょうりょくなじりょくでえものをひきよせうごかずかりをするがてんてきをひきよせることもある。

key: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
en: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
ja: 自分のシッポをおいかけまわすポケモン。やせいはもりのじゅもくのあなでくらす。あいくるしいかおでペットとしてだいにんき。

key: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
en: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
ja: きまったすみかをもたずにくらすポケモン。他のポケモンがねどこにちかよってきてもけっしてあらそわずねる場所をかえる。

key: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food-- raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
en: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food-- raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
ja: 体のひょうめんにくったほうせきのせいぶんがうきだす。そのパターンはむげんだいだ。

key: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
en: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
ja: ２つのくちをもつ。こうとうぶのおおアゴにはみかくがないためにがてなものはこちらでたべる。

key: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
en: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
ja: しんかのときはがねのよろいがはがれおちる。むかしのひとはひろってせいかつにやくだてた。

key: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
en: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
ja: 体をぶつけあってなわばりをあらそう。はがねのよろいはよくみるときずやへこみがあるのだ。

key: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
en: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
ja: おおむかしボスゴドラのつよさにあやかり頭のかたちをもしたかぶとをかぶるおうさまがいた。

key: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
en: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
ja: めいそうでせいしんエネルギーをたかめている。１にちにきのみを１こだけしかたべない。あまりたべないこともしゅぎょうのひとつ。

key: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.
en: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.
ja: ヨガの力でだい６かんがはったつしてサイコパワーをあやつれるようになった。１かげつかんなにもたべずにめいそうする。

key: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
en: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
ja: ながいたいもうがこすれあうことでぜんしんにせいでんきがたまる。スピードがじまんのポケモン。

key: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
en: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
ja: でんきできんにくをしげきするので素早くうごける。きんにくつうもでんきでほぐすのですぐ治る。

key: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
en: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
ja: なかまをおうえんするときはぜんしんからでんきのひばなをだしてパチパチひかる。なかまがまけるとおおごえでないてしまう。

key: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.
en: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.
ja: なかまのおうえんがだいすきなポケモン。なかまがまけそうになると体からでるひばなのかずがどんどんふえていくよ。

key: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
en: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
ja: しっぽのあかりをつかってしゅうだんでよぞらにきかがくてきなずけいをえがく。イルミーゼのだすあまいかおりがだいすき。

key: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads Volbeat swarms to draw patterns in the sky. Over 200 different patterns have been seen.
en: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads Volbeat swarms to draw patterns in the sky. Over 200 different patterns have been seen.
ja: バルビートをゆうどうしてサインをえがく。ふくざつなサインをえがくイルミーゼほどなかまからそんけいされるといわれているよ。

key: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
en: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
ja: みぎてとひだりてで２しゅるいのどくをつかいわけて攻撃する。かおりが強いほどげんきだ。

key: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
en: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
ja: 体のだいぶぶんがいぶくろでできていてしんぞうやのうみそはとてもちいさい。なんでもとかすとくしゅないえきをもつ。

key: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.
en: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.
ja: はが１ぽんもないのでなんでもまるのみ。いっぱいにあけたくちはとても大きくじどうしゃのタイヤだってすっぽりはいるぞ。

key: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
en: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
ja: じょうぶなアゴとキバはもくぞうのふねならかんたんにかみくだく。エサをめぐりバスラオとあらそう。

key: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
en: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
ja: おしりのあなからのみこんだかいすいをふきだしおよぐ。ちのにおいにはとてもびんかん。

key: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
en: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
ja: ごくごくまれにむれがすなはまにうち上がるのはおおむかしりくにすんでいたなごりといわれている。

key: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
en: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
ja: ちいさなホエルコがサメハダーやダダリンにおそわれるとむれのなかまがいちがんになって守る。

key: It stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. Numel is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
en: It stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. Numel is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
ja: １２００どのマグマを体にためている。みずにぬれるとマグマがひえてかたまりおもたくなるのでうごきがにぶってしまう。

key: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
en: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
ja: せなかのコブはほねがかたちをかえたもの。にえたぎったマグマを時々ふき上げる。おこったときによくふんかするらしい。

key: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.
en: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.
ja: せきたんをもやしてエネルギーをつくる。せきたんがもえつきるとみうごきがとれなくなってしまう。

key: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
en: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
ja: 頭にのせたしんじゅがバネブーのサイコパワーをたかめるはたらきをする。おおきなしんじゅをいつもさがしている。

key: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power for gaining total control over its foe. Its snorting grows labored when doing so.
en: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power for gaining total control over its foe. Its snorting grows labored when doing so.
ja: くろしんじゅをりようしてふしぎな力を使うとききみょうなステップでおどりだす。くろしんじゅはびじゅつひんのかちをもつ。

key: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.
en: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.
ja: １ぴきずつブチもようはことなる。フラフラしたうごきで相手の攻撃をぜつみょうにかわすぞ。

key: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
en: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
ja: わなをかねたすをつくりひたすらえものをまちかまえる。よるになるとすなにもぐりねる。

key: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
en: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
ja: ハネをしんどうさせおんぱをはっせいさせる。いっしょにいるトレーナーはみみせんが必要。

key: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
en: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
ja: うつくしいうたのようなはおとにこころをうばわれてさばくでそうなんするひとがぞくしゅつ。

key: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
en: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
ja: 雨の少ないきびしいかんきょうほどきれいでかおりの強いはなをさかせる。トゲのついたうでをふりまわして戦う。

key: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
en: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
ja: まよなかさばくをあるくたびびとのうしろをぞろぞろとしゅうだんでくっついてあるく。つかれてうごけなくなるのをまっているのだ。

key: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
en: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
ja: わたぐもにみえるためてきからみつかりにくい。せだいをかさねるうちつばさがしろくなったという。

key: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
en: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
ja: やさしいせいしつだがおこらせるとするどいなきごえでいかくしてようしゃない攻撃をくわえる。

key: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.
en: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.
ja: ふだんは４ほんあしで行動するがおこるとうしろあしでたちまえあしのツメがとびだす。ハブネークとはせんぞから続くライバルだ。

key: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's incredible agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
en: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's incredible agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
ja: かたなのようなしっぽはてきをきりさくのとどうじにしみだしたもうどくをあびせるぞ。しゅくてきザングースとたたかいつづける。

key: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
en: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
ja: ４０ねんまえにいんせきのおちた場所ではじめてみ使った。にらむだけでてきをねむらせる。

key: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
en: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
ja: たいようエネルギーがパワーのみなもとなのでひるまは強い。かいてんすると体がひかる。

key: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.
en: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.
ja: ヒゲにしんけいがあつまっている。にんげんのはなやベロのようににおいやあじをかんじとるぞ。

key: It can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
en: It can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
ja: しりょくはあまりよくない。ヒゲでみずのしんどうをかんちしてえもののいちをつきとめるのだ。

key: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.
en: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.
ja: かんきょうにてきおうする力がとても強い。よどんだドブにいるのはヒンバスとこいつくらいだ。

key: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.
en: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.
ja: よくハサミがもげる。ハサミのなかみはマケンカニやウデッポウとちがってドロくさくじつにまずい。

key: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.
en: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.
ja: なかまをみつけるとやかましくなきわめきあつまる。おおむかしのぼ力たいりょうにみつかる。

key: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.
en: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.
ja: こだいじんがそらからおりてきたなにかをもしてつくったらしい。りょううでからビームをはなつ。

key: It disguises itself as seaweed by swaying its tentacles. Unsuspecting prey that comes too close is swallowed whole.
en: It disguises itself as seaweed by swaying its tentacles. Unsuspecting prey that comes too close is swallowed whole.
ja: きょうりょくなきゅうばんでいわにはりついているのでどんなあらなみでも長されないのだ。

key: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
en: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.
ja: こだいのうみのにくしょくポケモン。８つのしょくしゅでえものをとらえしょうかえきでとかしながらくう。

key: It was resurrected from a fossil. Anorith swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
en: It was resurrected from a fossil. Anorith swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.
ja: こだいのむしポケモンのいっしゅ。８まいのハネをつかっていがいに素早くおよいでいたらしい。

key: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
en: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.
ja: うみからちじょうでくらすようになった。いちぶのむしポケモンのそせんであることがわかった。

key: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.
en: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.
ja: みすぼらしいのでたいていのひとはみむきもしないがヒンバスだけをあつめるコレクターだっているぞ。

key: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.
en: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.
ja: おおきなみずうみのそこにすむ。うつくしいその姿はみたもののこころのけがれをはらうという。

key: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
en: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
ja: 天気によって姿がかわる。きしょうがあらくなるほどきしょうもあらっぽくなってくる。

key: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
en: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.
ja: かくれるときいがいにもきぶんやちょうしで体のいろがかわる。いろがこいときほどげんきだぞ。

key: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
en: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.
ja: ひぐれにカゲボウズがならぶようないえとはつきあうなというふるいことわざがのこっている。

key: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
en: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.
ja: すてられたおんねんでうまれる。たいせつにされるとまんぞくしてもとのヌイグルミにもどるという。

key: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
en: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.
ja: 姿をとうめいにしてそっとえものにちかよる。あついカベをとおりぬける能力をもつ。

key: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
en: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.
ja: さまよっているひとだまをみつけからっぽのたいないにすいこむ。すいこまれてどうなるかはなぞ。

key: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
en: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.
ja: くびのフサがおいしくてにんき。あたたかいとちにはトロピウスをそだてるぼくじょうがたくさん。

key: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
en: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.
ja: 風が強くなるときのえだやのきしたに頭のきゅうばんでぶらさがりなきだす。ながいシッポできのみをつまんでたべる。

key: It sharply senses even subtle changes in sky and land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon with a life-span of 100 years.
en: It sharply senses even subtle changes in sky and land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon with a life-span of 100 years.
ja: ろうじんはわざわいポケモンとよびいみきらうがさいがいをよちする力にかんしんがたかまっている。

key: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
en: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.
ja: むれで行動するしゅうせい。眠るときはどうくつのなかでなかまたちと体をよせあう。

key: They tend to move about in groups of around five. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
en: They tend to move about in groups of around five. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
ja: さむいとちのかねもちはみんなこどものころにユキワラシとあそんだおもいでがあるらしい。

key: A Glalie has the power to immediately freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
en: A Glalie has the power to immediately freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.
ja: さほどかたくないいわがほんたい。くうきちゅうのすいぶんをこおらせこおりのそうこうをみにまとう。

key: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
en: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
ja: なみまにただよいうみのようすをさぐる。えものをはっけんするとむれのトドゼルガにしらせるのだ。

key: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
en: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.
ja: タマザラシやモンスターボールなどまるいものならなんでもはなのうえでまわしてしまうしゅうせい。

key: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
en: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.
ja: キバはいっしょうのびつづける。たたかいでおれても１ねんあればもとのりっぱなキバにもどる。

key: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
en: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.
ja: パールルのしんじゅはとてもきちょう。シェルダーのしんじゅの１０ばいいじょうかちがあるとも。

key: To withstand the pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
en: To withstand the pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
ja: しんかいにせいそく。ハンテールがはまにうち上がるとふきつなことがおこるといういいつたえがある。

key: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.
en: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.
ja: えもののたいえきをすう。にくはかいていにしずみ他のポケモンのエサになるのだ。

key: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
en: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
ja: １おくねんかんまったく姿がかわっていないのはせいめいとしてかんせいされているかららしい。

key: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.
en: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.
ja: あたたかいうみのサンゴしょうがすみか。サニーゴのえだのあいだで眠るのがとくにおきにいり。

key: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
en: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.
ja: 頭を強くうちつけることでしんかにえいきょうするさいぼうをしげきしているというせつもある。

key: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
en: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.
ja: どうくつのおくふかくにすむ。かたいカラのなかにとじこもりそらをとぶひをゆめみている。

key: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
en: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
ja: 強くねがい続けてきたけっか体のさいぼうがとつぜんへんい。ねんがんのつばさをてにいれた。

key: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
en: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
ja: おこらせるとあばれるだけでなく強いじりょくをはなつのできかいのたぐいはこわれてしまう。

key: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
en: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
ja: こうそくでそらをとび周りえものをみつけるとするどいツメでがっちりつかんではなさないのだ。

key: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.
en: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.
ja: スーパーコンピュータよりもすごいはんだんで相手をぶんせきしれいせいにおいつめていくのだ。

key: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.
en: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.
ja: さいしんのかがくぎじゅつをつかいいわの体をしらべたがのうやしんぞうをみつけられなかった。

key: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
en: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
ja: ひょうがじだいにつくられたこおりの体はほのおでもとかすことができない。マイナス２００どのれいきをあやつる。

key: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. It can also shrink and stretch flexibly.
en: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. It can also shrink and stretch flexibly.
ja: ちかのマントルのなかでうまれておよそ１まんねんまえにちじょうにでてきたとうわさされている。

key: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.
en: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.
ja: ちのうがたかくひとのことばをりかいする。ガラスのようなうもうで体をつつみこみ光をくっせつさせて姿をかえる。

key: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions telepathically. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
en: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions telepathically. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
ja: やさしいこころのもちぬしにしかなつかない。うでをおりたたむとくうきていこうがへってジェットきよりも速くそらをとべるぞ。

key: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
en: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
ja: うみのけしんとつたわるポケモン。しぜんのエネルギーをもとめてグラードンとあらそいをくりかえしたでんせつがある。

key: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
en: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
ja: しぜんのエネルギーによってゲンシカイキしほんらいの姿をとりもどす。その力はマグマをうみだしだいちをひろげる。

key: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.
en: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.
ja: オゾンそうをとびつづけエサとなるいんせきをくらう。たいないにたまったいんせきのエネルギーでメガシンカする。

key: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
en: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
ja: １０００ねんの眠りからめざめたとき頭のたんざくにかかれたねがいごとをかなえるという。

key: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
en: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
ja: うちゅうウィルスからたんじょうしたポケモン。ちのうがたかくちょう能力をあやつる。むねのすいしょうたいからレーザーをだす。

key: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
en: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
ja: ぜんしんでこうごうせいをしてさんそをつくる。のどがかわくと頭のはっぱがしおれてしまう。

key: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
en: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
ja: もりのなかのみずべでくらす。ひるまはもりのそとにでてこうらのきに光をあてる。

key: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
en: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
ja: ちいさなポケモンたちがあつまりうごかないドダイトスのせなかですづくりをはじめることがある。

key: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
en: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
ja: おなかでつくられたガスがおしりでもえている。たいちょうがわるいとほのおが弱くなる。

key: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
en: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
ja: てんじょうやかべをりようしてくうちゅうさっぽうをくりだす。しっぽのほのおもぶきのひとつ。

key: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
en: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
ja: 素早さで相手をほんろうする。りょうてりょうあしを使ったどくとくのたたかいかたをする。

key: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
en: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
ja: プライドがたかくひとからたべものをもらうことをきらう。ながいうぶげがさむさを防ぐ。

key: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
en: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
ja: むれをつくらずに１ぴきでいる。自分がいちばんえらいとどのポッタイシもかんがえているようだ。

key: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
en: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
ja: クチバシからのびている３ぼんのツノはつよさのしょうちょう。リーダーがいちばんおおきい。

key: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
en: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
ja: たくさんのむれで行動する。体はちいさいがはばたく力はひじょうに強い。

key: It flies around forests and fields in search of Bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
en: It flies around forests and fields in search of Bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
ja: もりやそうげんにせいそく。グループがでくわすとなわばりをかけたあらそいがはじまる。

key: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
en: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
ja: ムクホークになるとむれからはなれて１ぴきでいきていく。きょうじんなつばさをもっている。

key: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
en: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
ja: なにごとにもどうじないずぶといしんけいのもちぬし。みかけのわりにはきびんにかつどうする。

key: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
en: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
ja: かわをきのみきやどろのダムでせきとめてすみかをつくる。はたらきものとしてしられている。

key: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
en: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
ja: しょっかくどうしがぶつかるとコロンコロンともっきんににたねいろをかなでる。

key: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
en: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
ja: なくときはナイフのようなうでをむねのまえでこうささせる。そっきょうでメロディをつくる。

key: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
en: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
ja: きけんをかんじるとぜんしんのたいもうがひかる。相手がめをくらませているあいだににげる。

key: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
en: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
ja: いっぱつできぜつさせるほどのでんりゅうをツメからながす。すうひきのグループでくらす。

key: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
en: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
ja: とうしはでんきエネルギーをひどくしょうもうするためちょう時間眠りエネルギーをたくわえる。

key: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
en: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
ja: ふゆのあいだはつぼみをとざしてさむさにたえる。はるになるとつぼみをひらきかふんを飛ばす。

key: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
en: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
ja: みぎてのどくはそっこうせい。ひだりてのどくはちこうせい。どちらもいのちにかかわるぞ。

key: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
en: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
ja: かたいずがいこつがとくちょう。ずつきでじゅもくをへしおってみのったきのみをくっていた。

key: Its powerful head-butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
en: Its powerful head-butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
ja: ずつきがとくいなこだいのポケモン。ほんとうにのうみそがちいさいのでおろかでほろんだというせつもある。

key: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
en: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
ja: たいこのちそうからかせきがみつかるがかおのぶぶんいがいがはっけんされたことはない。

key: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
en: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
ja: しょうめんからの攻撃は全てはねかえす。くさやきのみをたべるおとなしいせいかく。

key: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
ja: つめたいこがらしを防ぐためこえだやおちばをざいりょうにミノをつくり体をおおう。

key: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
en: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
ja: ミノムッチからしんかしたときミノが体のいちぶになった。いっしょうミノをぬぐことはない。

key: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
en: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
ja: はなのミツがだいすき。ミツハニーのあつめたミツをよこどりしてたべてしまう。

key: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.
en: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.
ja: よあけからひぐれまでミツをあつめつづける。全てはむれとビークインのためだ。

key: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
en: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
ja: どうたいがこどもたちのすあなになっている。ミツハニーのあつめたミツでこどもたちをそだてる。

key: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
en: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
ja: せいでんきがたまってパチパチするけだまをだいこうぶつのきのみといっしょにみきのあなにかくす。

key: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
en: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
ja: くびのうきぶくろをふくらませすいめんからかおをだしてあたりのようすをうかがっている。

key: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
en: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
ja: はったつしたうきぶくろでうかぶ。おぼれたひとをきゅうじょするてつだいをしているポケモンだ。

key: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
en: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
ja: 体があかいチェリンボほどえいようがおおくたまのあじもあまくておいしいよ。

key: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
en: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
ja: たたんだはなびらはかたい。とりポケモンにつっつかれてもぜんぜんへいきなのだ。

key: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
en: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
ja: キケンをかんじるとむらさきいろのしるをだす。あぶらあせのようなものだとかんがえられている。

key: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
en: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
ja: すむ場所やエサのえいきょうでいろやかたちが変化する。なみのおだやかないそべに多い。

key: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
en: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
ja: ２ほんのしっぽできのみのからをきようにむいてたべる。ほんもののうではほとんどつかわなくなった。

key: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
en: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
ja: ひとやポケモンのたましいがかたまってうまれたポケモン。ジメジメしたきせつがだいすき。

key: It is drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
en: It is drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
ja: たいないのガスのげんりょうはたましい。体がしぼんでくるとひとやポケモンをつれさるという。

key: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
en: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
ja: かたほうのみみをいつもまるめているのはてきにおそわれたときすぐにはんげきするためだ。

key: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
en: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
ja: けいかいしんが強くたたかいはこのまないがしなやかなあしからパワフルなキックをくりだすぞ。

key: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing them are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
en: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing them are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
ja: のろいのことばをつぶやいてひどいずつうやおそろしいまぼろしをみせてくるしめる。

key: A gentle but misleadingly strong Pokémon, it helps those who got lost in the wetlands find their way out... At the cost of a little of their life force.
en: A gentle but misleadingly strong Pokémon, it helps those who got lost in the wetlands find their way out... At the cost of a little of their life force.
ja: おだやかに見えて力強いポケモン。しっちで道にまよった者を出口までみちびく……そのいのちを少しだけもらいながら。

key: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
en: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
ja: よるになるとかつどうをはじめる。たくさんのヤミカラスをひきつれむれをつくることでしられる。

key: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
en: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
ja: きにいらないとツメをたてるがたまにのどをならしてあまえるせいかくがいちぶにだいにんきだ。

key: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.
en: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.
ja: 体を大きくみせて相手をいあつするためふたまたのしっぽでウエストをぎゅっとしぼっている。

key: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
en: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
ja: とびはねるとくちのなかにあるたまがあちこちにはんしゃしてすずのようなねいろとなる。

key: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
en: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
ja: おしりからきょうれつにくさいえきたいをとばしてみを守る。においは２４時間きえない。

key: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
en: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
ja: しっぽのさきからひどいにおいのえきたいをとばして攻撃する。ひきょりは５０メートルいじょう。

key: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
en: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
ja: ふるいおはかからドーミラーにそっくりな道具がほりだされたがかんけいはわかっていない。

key: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
en: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
ja: 体のもようからほんらいガラルにはいないポケモンとかんがえるがくしゃも多い。

key: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.
en: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.
ja: あまり体がしめりすぎるとしんでしまうのであせのようにめからすいぶんをだしている。

key: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
en: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
ja: 相手のうごきをモノマネするしゅうせい。まねをされた相手はめがはなせなくなるという。

key: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.
en: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.
ja: しろくまるいものをみるとはらのふくろにしまう。しまいすぎてうごけなくなることもあるほど。

key: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
en: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
ja: ひとのことばをおぼえてなく。なかまがいっかしょにあつまるとみんな同じことばをおぼえる。

key: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
en: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
ja: １０８このたましいがあつまってうまれたポケモン。かなめいしのひびわれにつながれている。

key: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that strays too close.
en: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that strays too close.
ja: アローラよりさらにあついとちがほんらいのすみか。いっしょにすむならだんぼうだいがかかる。

key: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
en: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
ja: だっぴして大きくなっていく。ウロコをすってこなにしたものはかんぽうやくのげんりょうになる。

key: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
en: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
ja: 体をおりたたみつばさをのばすとまるでジェットき。おんそくでとぶことができる。

key: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
en: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
ja: くえそうなものだったらとりあえずひろってまるのみ。くさったエサでもへいきながんじょうないをもつ。

key: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
en: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
ja: 体からはっするはどうはこわいときかなしいときにつよまりピンチをなかまにつたえる。

key: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
en: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
ja: はどうのなみで相手のきもちをキャッチする。しりたくないこともわかるのでストレスをためやすい。

key: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
en: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
ja: かんそうしたとちでくらす。あせのかわりにすなつぶを体からぶんぴつするポケモン。

key: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
en: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
ja: たいないにためたすなを体のあなからふきあげてきょだいなたつまきをつくり攻撃する。

key: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
en: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
ja: しっぽのツメでえものをはさみどくをおくりこむ。どくがきくまで絶対にはなさないしゅうねん。

key: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
en: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
ja: りょううでのツメはじどうしゃをスクラップにするはか威力。ツメのさきからどくをだす。

key: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
en: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
ja: ほっぺたにどくぶくろをもつ。相手のすきをついてもうどくをにじませているゆびをつきさす。

key: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
en: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
ja: こぶしのトゲからはかすりきずでもいのちをおとすほどのもうどくをぶんぴつしている。

key: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
en: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
ja: あまいにおいのだえきでえものをおびきよせおおあごでがぶり。１にちかけてえものをたべる。

key: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
en: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
ja: たいようをいっぱいにあびたおびれのもようはくらくなるとあざやかないろで光だす。

key: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
en: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
ja: ふかいうみのそこでくらす。４まいのひれのもようをひからせえものをおびきよせる。

key: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
en: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
ja: ひとなつっこくにんげんのふねのちかくまでよってくる。せなかのもようはちいきによってことなる。

key: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
en: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
ja: おなかにみのるアイスみたいなきのみはガラルにくらすダルマッカたちのだいこうぶつ。

key: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
en: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
ja: ブリザードをまきおこすポケモン。おおきな体をゆすればあたりいちめんすぐにまっしろだ。

key: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
en: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
ja: さむいちいきでくらすポケモン。４、５ひきのグループはみごとなれんけいでえものをおいつめる。

key: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
en: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
ja: とくしゅなじばのえいきょうでレアコイルがしんかした。３つのユニットからじりょくをだす。

key: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
en: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
ja: ぐんぐんのびるベロをなんにでもまきつける。うかつにちかよるとだえきでべとべとにされてしまう。

key: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
en: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
ja: いわをてのひらのあなにつめてきんにくの力ではっしゃする。まれにイシツブテを飛ばす。

key: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
en: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
ja: しょくぶつのツルでできたうでをのばしてえものをからめとる。うでをたべられてもへっちゃら。

key: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
en: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
ja: ２ほんのしっぽのさきを相手におしあてて２まんボルトいじょうのでんりゅうをながして攻撃。

key: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
en: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
ja: ひのたまをうちだしててきをしとめる。まっくろコゲになるのでえものをとるときにはつかわない。

key: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
en: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
ja: めぐみを与えるそんざいといわれておりおおむかしからえんぎものにえがかれてきた。

key: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
en: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
ja: ６ほんのあしでおとなをかかえてらくらくととぶことができる。しっぽのはねでバランスをとる。

key: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
en: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
ja: しょくぶつのようにこうごうせいをするためリーフィアの周りはすんだくうきにつつまれている。

key: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
en: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
ja: いっしゅんでしゅういのすいぶんをこおらせこおりのつぶをつくりえものめがけてうちだすのだ。

key: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops.
en: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops.
ja: しっぽできのえだにぶらさがりえものをかんさつする。すきをみてじょうくうからおそいかかる。

key: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long time.
en: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long time.
ja: みためどおりの力もち。こおりのキバはさむくなるほどふとくながくりっぱになる。

key: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
en: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
ja: よりすぐれたポケモンにするためプログラムをついかしたがなぜかおかしな行動をはじめた。

key: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
en: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
ja: のびちぢみするひじのかたなで戦う。いあいのめいしゅ。れいぎただしいポケモン。

key: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
en: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
ja: ぜんしんから強いじりょくをだしている。３このチビノーズとよばれるユニットをあやつる。

key: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
en: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
ja: 頭のアンテナでれいかいからのでんぱをじゅしん。しじをうけてひとをれいかいへつれていくのだ。

key: It freezes foes with an icy breath of nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
en: It freezes foes with an icy breath of nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
ja: ひどいふぶきのばんにひとざとにおりてくるという。ノックされてもドアをあけてはいけないぞ。

key: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
en: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
ja: プラズマでできた体をもつ。でんかせいひんにもぐりこみわるさをすることでしられている。

key: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
en: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
ja: ちしきのかみとよばれている。めをあわせたもののきおくをけしてしまう力をもつという。

key: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
en: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
ja: かなしみのくるしさとよろこびのとうとさをひとびとにおしえた。かんじょうのかみとよばれている。

key: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
en: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
ja: いしのかみとよばれている。みずうみのそこで眠りつづけせかいのバランスをとっている。

key: It has the power to control time. It appears as an ancient deity in myths of the Sinnoh Region.
en: It has the power to control time. It appears as an ancient deity in myths of the Sinnoh Region.
ja: 時間をあやつる力をもつ。シンオウちほうではかみさまとよばれしんわに登場する。

key: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in the Sinnoh Region's mythology.
en: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in the Sinnoh Region's mythology.
ja: くうかんをゆがめる能力をもちシンオウちほうのしんわではかみさまとしてえがかれている。

key: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
en: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
ja: かざんのほらあなにせいそく。じゅうじのツメをくいこませてカベやてんじょうをはいまわる。

key: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon having towed continents with ropes.
en: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon having towed continents with ropes.
ja: さまざまなざいりょうでポケモンをつくってからたいりくをげんざいの場所にいどうさせたといわれる。

key: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
en: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
ja: あばれものゆえおいだされたがやぶれたせかいといわれる場所でしずかにもとのせかいをみていた。

key: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
en: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
ja: ひこうするときはベールのようなはねからひかるりゅうしをだす。みかづきのけしんとよばれている。

key: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
en: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
ja: あたたかいうみをただよっている。どんなとおくに長されてもうまれた場所に必ずもどる。

key: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
en: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
ja: どんなポケモンとでもこころをかよいあわせることができるふしぎな能力をもっている。

key: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
en: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
ja: ひとびとをふかい眠りにさそいゆめをみせる能力をもつ。しんげつのよるにかつどうする。

key: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
en: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
ja: グラシデアのはながさくきせつかんしゃのこころをとどけるためにとびたつといわれている。

key: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
en: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
ja: うちゅうがまだないころにさいしょにうまれたポケモンとしんわのなかでかたられている。

key: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
en: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
ja: ビクティニがむげんにうみだすエネルギーをわけあたえてもらうとぜんしんにパワーがあふれだす。

key: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
en: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
ja: しっぽでたいようをあびてこうごうせいをする。げんきをなくすとしっぽがたれ下がる。

key: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.
en: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.
ja: 体がよごれるとはっぱでこうごうせいができなくなるのでいつもせいけつにしている。

key: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
en: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
ja: にらむだけで相手のうごきをとめてしまう。たいようエネルギーをたいないでぞうふくさせる。

key: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
en: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
ja: やいたきのみをたべるのがだいすきだがこうふんしすぎて時々まっくろこげにしちゃう。

key: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.
en: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.
ja: たいないのほのおがもえ上がるとうごきのキレとスピードがます。ピンチになるとけむりをふきだす。

key: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
en: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
ja: ほのおのあごひげをたくわえる。パワーとスピードをかねそなえたかくとうのわざをみにつけている。

key: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same element as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.
en: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same element as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.
ja: おなかのホタチで戦う。攻撃をうけとめてからすかさずきりつけてはんげきするのだ。

key: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
en: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
ja: きびしいしゅぎょうのすえフタチマルごとにことなるかたのホタチさばきをしゅうとくする。

key: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.
en: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.
ja: よろいにしこまれたつるぎのひとふりで相手を倒す。ひとにらみでてきをだまらせる。

key: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.
en: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.
ja: けいかいしんが強く必ずいっぴきはみはりをしているのだがうしろからのてきにはきづかない。

key: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
en: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
ja: ほっぺのふくろにためたきのみのタネをとばして攻撃。てきをはっけんするとしっぽをたてる。

key: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
en: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.
ja: かおをおおうながいけはすぐれたレーダー。しゅういのようすをびんかんにさっちする。

key: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.
en: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.
ja: おおむかしのへきがに姿がえがかれているほどながいあいだひととくらしをともにしてきた。

key: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
en: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
ja: ながくあつでのたいもうをもつ。むかしはさむいちほうでは１かに１ぴきムーランドをかっていた。

key: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
en: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
ja: かわいらしいしぐさでゆだんさせてそのすきに持ち物をうばう。おこるとツメをたててはんげき。

key: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
en: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
ja: けはいをころしてせっきんする。相手がきづくまえにはいごからしのびよりしとめてしまうのだ。

key: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
en: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
ja: げんきのないポケモンに頭のはっぱをわけ与える。つかれをとる効果があるのだ。

key: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
en: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
ja: トゲのたくさんついたしっぽを相手にたたきつけて攻撃。きしょうのはげしいポケモン。

key: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.
en: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.
ja: かざんのほらあなでくらす。頭のふさのなかがもえていて３００どのこうおんになる。

key: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
en: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
ja: 体のなかのほのおをもやして頭やしっぽからひのこをまきちらせててきをこがす。

key: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.
en: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.
ja: 頭のふさにためたみずはえいようたっぷり。しょくぶつにかけると大きくそだつのだ。

key: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
en: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
ja: しっぽからこうあつのみずをはっしゃするとコンクリートのかべもはかいする威力。

key: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
en: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
ja: ひとやポケモンがみたゆめをたべる。たのしいゆめをたべるとピンクいろのけむりをはきだす。

key: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.
en: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.
ja: いつもまどろみゆめをみている。ねおきはとってもふきげんになるのでそっとしておこう。

key: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
en: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
ja: まちなかでくらしているポケモン。ひとなつっこいのでこうえんやひろばにたくさんあつまってくる。

key: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
en: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
ja: ハトーボーのすむもりのおくにはあらそいのないへいわなくにがあるとしんじられている。

key: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
en: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
ja: オスは頭にかざりをもつ。トレーナーいがいのひとにはけっしてなつかないせいしつ。

key: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
en: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
ja: かみなりぐもでそらがおおわれるとあらわれる。たてがみでカミナリをキャッチしてでんきをためる。

key: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
en: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
ja: はげしいきしょうのもちぬし。あらぶるとたてがみからかみなりをしほうはっぽうにほうでんする。

key: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
en: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
ja: １００ねんまえのだいじしんのときじわれからはっけんされた。たいないにエネルギーコアをもつ。

key: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
en: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
ja: たいないにおさまりきらずにもれだしたエネルギーがかたまりオレンジいろのけっしょうになった。

key: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
en: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
ja: たいようこうせんをきゅうしゅうしエネルギーをうちだす。ふだんはちちゅうふかくにみをひそめている。

key: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
en: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
ja: ちょうおんぱをはなちながらフラフラととび周りエサのむしポケモンをさがしている。

key: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
en: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
ja: オスがメスにきゅうあいするときはっするちょうおんぱをあびるととてもたのしいきぶんになる。

key: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
en: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
ja: りょうてのツメをかさねあわせて体をこうそくかいてんさせるともうスピードでちちゅうをすすむ。

key: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
en: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
ja: ちか１００メートルにめいろのようなすあなをつくる。ちかてつのトンネルにあなをあけてしまう。

key: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.
en: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.
ja: こころやさしいポケモン。しょっかくをおしあて相手のきもちやたいちょうをりかいする。

key: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
en: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
ja: いつもかくざいをかかえている。けんちくげんばにあらわれてこうじをてつだうポケモン。

key: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.
en: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.
ja: てっこつをたくみにあやつる。かいたいはとくいだがなにかをくみたてるのはにがてなのだ。

key: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.
en: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.
ja: ほんきになるとコンクリートのはしらをすてさりこぶしひとつで相手にめがけとびかかる。

key: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
en: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
ja: ほほをしんどうさせてひとにはきこえないおんぱをだす。おんぱのリズムでかいわする。

key: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
en: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
ja: きれいなこえでなくこともある。体のとっきがおおきいほどひろいおんいきでなけるのだ。

key: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
en: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
ja: こぶしのコブをしんどうさせるとパンチの威力がばいぞうする。一撃でおおいわをふんさい。

key: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
en: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
ja: ５ひきのむれでけいこにはげむ。けいこについていけないものはおびをすててむれをさる。

key: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
en: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
ja: おびをしめるときあいがはいりパンチのはか威力がます。しゅぎょうをジャマするとおこる。

key: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
en: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
ja: はっぱをかみきりく力だすねんちゃくいとでぬいあわせて自分でふくをつくるポケモン。

key: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
en: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
ja: はっぱで体をつつみこんでさむさを防ぐ。てぢかなおちばをたべながらもりをいどうする。

key: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
