en: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
ja: おちばがはっこうするねつでタマゴをあたためる。クルミルにはっぱでおくるみをつくる。

key: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.
en: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.
ja: キバにもうどくをもっている。くえそうなえものをみつけるとあとさきかんがえずとびかかる。

key: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
en: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
ja: ふだんはうごかないがおそわれるとこうそくかいてんしてはしり周りたいあたりではんげきするのだ。

key: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into and poison its opponents.
en: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into and poison its opponents.
ja: なわばりをめぐりマルヤクデとはげしくあらそう。まけたほうはそのままえものになるのだ。

key: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.
en: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.
ja: おそわれると体のワタをとばしておとりにする。とばしたワタはまたすぐにはえてくるぞ。

key: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.
en: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.
ja: とくていのすみかをもたない。つむじ風にのってあちこちにあらわれてはイタズラをするのだ。

key: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
en: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
ja: すいぶんとえいようのほうふなつちをこのむのでチュリネのすむとちはさくもつのそだちがよい。

key: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
en: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
ja: 頭のはなかざりのかおりにはリラックスさせる効果がある。ていれをなまけるとかれてしまう。

key: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
en: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
ja: あかとあおのバスラオはなかがわるいがなぜかいろのちがうこたいがむれにまぎれこんでいる。

key: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
en: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.
ja: すなのなかにもぐりめとはなをそとにだしていどうする。くろいまくがめを守る。

key: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
en: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
ja: めをおおうとくしゅなまくがぶったいのねつをかんちするためくらやみでも周りがみえるのだ。

key: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.
en: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.
ja: フライゴンのおこす砂嵐にみをひそめてえものがくるのをじっとまちかまえている。

key: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
en: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
ja: ダルマッカのフンはあついのでむかしのひとはふところにいれて体をあたためていたのだ。

key: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
en: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
ja: たいないのほのおがもえさかるほどパワーがたかまる。そのおんどは１４００どをこえることも。

key: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.
en: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.
ja: 傷つくと動きをとめる。石のようにじっとしたまま心と精神をとぎすますのだ。

key: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
en: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
ja: かんそうしたとちでくらす。体をリズミカルにうごかすとマラカスのようなおとをかなでる。

key: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
en: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
ja: てごろないしにあなをあけてすみかにする。こわされるとかわりのいしがみつかるまでおちつかない。

key: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
en: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
ja: おもたいいわをせおってかんそうしたとちをなんにちでもいどうできるきゃくりょくをもつ。

key: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
en: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
ja: だるんとのびたかわをくびまでひっぱりあげてガード。かわがのびているこたいほどえらいらしい。

key: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
en: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
ja: とさかのおおきさでグループのリーダーをきめる。キック攻撃でコンクリートブロックをはかいする。

key: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
en: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
ja: こだいとしのまもりがみだった。なわばりにしんにゅうしたてきをサイコパワーで攻撃する。

key: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.
en: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.
ja: こだいじんのたましいがポケモンになった。自分のかおをしるひとをさがしいせきをさまよう。

key: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.
en: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.
ja: ふるいおはかのかべにおうさまのとみのしょうちょうとしてえがかれていることが多い。

key: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
en: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
ja: およそ１おくねんまえのうみをおよいでいた。りくちへあがってえものにおそいかかることもある。

key: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
en: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
ja: かたいこうらをさらにじょうぶにするためにとらえたえものはカラやホネまでのこさずくうのだ。

key: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
en: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
ja: かせきからふっかつしたポケモン。あらゆるとりポケモンのそせんとかんがえられている。

key: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
en: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
ja: とりポケモンのそせんといわれる。はばたくきんにくがまだ弱くじょそうをつけなければとべない。

key: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
en: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
ja: ゴミぶくろがさんぎょうはいきぶつとかがく変化をおこしたことでポケモンとしてうまれかわった。

key: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.
en: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.
ja: アローラのダストダスが少したくましいのはベトベトンというてんてきがいるせいだといわれる。

key: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
en: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
ja: ひとや他のポケモンにばける。自分のしょうたいをかくすことできけんからみを守っているのだ。

key: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
en: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
ja: いっぺんにおおぜいのひとをばかす力をもつ。まぼろしのけしきをみせてすみかを守る。

key: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
en: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
ja: きれいずきなせいかくのポケモン。しっぽをほうきがわりにいつもすみかのほこりをはらっている。

key: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
en: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
ja: しろいたいもうははだざわりがばつぐん。ほこりやせいでんきをまったくよせつけないのだ。

key: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
en: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
ja: ポケモンやトレーナーをじっとかんさつする。ゴチムにしかみえないなにかをみつめているらしい。

key: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
en: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
ja: ほしあかりがパワーのみなもと。よるになるとサイコパワーでいしをうかべてほしのはいちをしるす。

key: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.
en: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.
ja: ほしの場所やうごきからみらいのできごとをよちする。トレーナーのじゅみょうもみえる。

key: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
en: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
ja: とくしゅなえきたいに体をつつんでいるのでうちゅうでもいきられるともいわれている。

key: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.
en: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.
ja: ぶんれつした２つののうみそのかんがえはほぼいっちせずまるで行動がよめない。

key: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.
en: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.
ja: とくしゅなえきたいをのむとちえをさずかるといわれるがランクルスいがいにはもうどく。

key: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
en: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
ja: てきにおそわれるとぜんしんのうもうからみずしぶきをだす。みずけむりにまぎれてにげるのだ。

key: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
en: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
ja: よあけとともにスワンナたちはおどりはじめる。まんなかでおどるスワンナがむれのリーダー。

key: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.
en: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.
ja: あさひのエネルギーをあびたつららがポケモンになった。ゆきに体をうめて眠る。

key: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.
en: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.
ja: ひょうがきをいきぬいたとてもたくましいポケモン。ことあついちほうではばつぐんのにんき。

key: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
en: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
ja: ２つの頭がどうじにおこるとツノからもうふぶきをふきだす。あたりをおおゆきでうめてしまう。

key: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
en: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
ja: きせつのかわりめになるとたいもうとにおいが変化する。きせつをつげるポケモン。

key: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
en: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
ja: きせつのうつりかわりとともにすみかをかえるのでメブキジカがはるをはこぶというひともいる。

key: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
en: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
ja: もりのきのうえでくらす。マントのようなまくのうちがわをほうでんさせながらかっくうする。

key: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.
en: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.
ja: く力はきだすえきたいでチョボマキのからをとかす。なかみだけをいただくのだ。

key: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
en: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
ja: チョボマキのカラをみにつけてしんかしたポケモン。こうてつのよろいがぜんしんをガードする。

key: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.
en: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.
ja: りょうてからふきだすほうしはもうどくだがよくかわかせばおなかのくすりになるという。

key: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
en: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
ja: モンスターボールのカサをみせつけえものをおびきよせようとするがだまされるポケモンは少ない。

key: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
en: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
ja: えものをどくでしびれさせて８０００メートルのしんかいにあるというすみかにつれていく。

key: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.
en: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.
ja: りょうしがおそれるそんざい。うみにひきずりこみいのちをうばうとウワサされている。

key: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
en: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.
ja: おおうなばらをただよってくらす。きずついたポケモンをみつけるとだきかかえてきしまではこぶ。

key: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
en: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
ja: 体のおおきなポケモンにとりついてせいでんきをすいとりちくでんぶくろにでんきをためる。

key: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
en: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
ja: でんきをおびたいとでわなをしかける。かんでんしてうごけないえものをゆっくりといただくのだ。

key: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
en: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
ja: こけむしたどうくつをこのむ。こけがふくむこうそがトゲを大きくじょうぶにはぐくむのだ。

key: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
en: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
ja: ほらあなのてんじょうにはりつきしたをとおるえものにむかっててつのトゲをうちこみおそう。

key: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
en: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.
ja: ２つの体がかみあいかいてんすることでいきるためのエネルギーをつくりだしている。

key: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.
en: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.
ja: こうぎょうぎじゅつのシンボルとしておおくのガラルのかいしゃできぎょうロゴにさいようされる。

key: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
en: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
ja: あかいコアのついたギアをこうそくかいてんさせてエネルギーをきゅうそくチャージするのだ。

key: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.
en: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.
ja: 弱いでんきしかだせないのでたくさんのシビシラスであつまりきょうりょくなでんきをはなつ。

key: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
en: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
ja: しょくよくおうせいなポケモン。えものをみつけるとおそいかかりでんきでしびれさせてからたべる。

key: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
en: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
ja: きゅうばんのくちでえものにすいつきくいこませたキバからでんきをながしてかんでんさせる。

key: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.
en: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.
ja: およそ５０ねんまえちじょうにおちたＵＦＯからあらわれたといわれるなぞの多いポケモン。

key: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.
en: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.
ja: サイコパワーで相手ののうみそをあやつりきおくするえいぞうをちがうものにかきかえてしまう。

key: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
en: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.
ja: あかりをともしてみちあんないをするようにみせかけながらせいめ威力をすいとっている。

key: It arrives near the moment of death and steals the spirit from the body.
en: It arrives near the moment of death and steals the spirit from the body.
ja: ランプのふりをしてまちなかにひそむ。しきがちかいひとをみつけるとそっとあとをつける。

key: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
en: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
ja: シャンデラのほのおにつつまれるとたましいがすいとられもやされる。ぬけがらの体だけがのこる。

key: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
en: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
ja: キバでじゅもくにきずをつけてなわばりのめじるしにする。キバはおれてもすぐにはえる。

key: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
en: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
ja: おおいわをくだくキバをもつ。なわばりをめぐるオノンドたちのあらそいはひじょうにはげしい。

key: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
en: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
ja: てっこつをきりつけてもはこぼれしないがんじょうなキバをもつ。かたいよろいにおおわれている。

key: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
en: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.
ja: いつもはなみずをたらしている。はなみずをすすってわざをだす。はなみずがわざのもとなのだ。

key: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
en: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
ja: はくいきをこおらせてこおりのキバやツメをつくり戦う。きたのさむいとちでくらす。

key: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
en: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
ja: ゆきぐものなかでうまれた。こおりのけっしょうでできたくさりでえものをつかまえる。

key: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
en: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
ja: カブルモとともにでんきてきなエネルギーをあびるとしんかする。りゆうはかいめいされていない。

key: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
en: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
ja: おもいカラをぬいだためにみがるになった。まるでにんじゃのようなみのこなしで戦う。

key: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touches it, it delivers a jolt of energy.
en: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touches it, it delivers a jolt of energy.
ja: 体のきいろいもようから強いでんきをはなつときなぜか少しほほえんでいる。

key: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.
en: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.
ja: やまおくにこもりむれのなかまとしゅぎょうにはげむ。むれによってキックやチョップのかたがちがう。

key: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
en: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
ja: きみょうなこえでほえたらキケン。めにもとまらぬキックやチョップのれんぞく攻撃がはじまるぞ。

key: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
en: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
ja: せまいほらあなをはしり周りえものをするどいツメでほかく。かおのひふはいわよりかたい。

key: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.
en: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.
ja: こだいじんがしもべにするためねんどをこねてこしらえたらしいがエネルギーげんはふめいだ。

key: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
en: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
ja: ゴルーグをつくったこだいじんからひとやポケモンを守るようにめいれいされているといわれている。

key: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.
en: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.
ja: キリキザンのめいれいのままにてきをおそう。相手をきりさくとりょうてのやいばをうちならすぞ。

key: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
en: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
ja: おおぜいのコマタナをしたがえてえものをむれでおいつめる。とどめはキリキザンがさす。

key: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
en: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
ja: みさかいなくとっしんしてずつきをくらわせる。はしっているれっしゃをだっせんさせるはか威力。

key: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
en: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
ja: 強い相手にもみさかいなくたたかいをいどむ。たたかいをくりかえすことで強くなるのだ。

key: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
en: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
ja: そらのゆうしゃのいみょうをもつ。きずついてもにげることのないほこりたかくゆうもうなポケモン。

key: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
en: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
ja: たべざかりのそだちざかり。体のせいちょうにあわせてガイコツをなんどもはきかえるよ。

key: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
en: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
ja: そらからちじょうをかんさつしてよわったえものにおそいかかる。ほねできかざるしゅうせい。

key: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.
en: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.
ja: こうおんでもえるほのおのしたでアイアントのはがねの体をとかしてなかみをいただくのだ。

key: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.
en: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.
ja: おおきなアゴはがんせきをもかみくだく。サダイジャからタマゴを守るためむれで戦う。

key: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
en: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
ja: めがみえないためたいあたりしたりかみついて周りをさぐる。体じゅうなまきずがたえない。

key: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.
en: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.
ja: １つのエサを２つの頭でうばいあう。だれともたたかっていないのにいつもキズだらけだ。

key: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
en: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
ja: りょううでの頭はのうみそをもたない。３つの頭で全てをたべつくしはかいしてしまう。

key: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
en: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
ja: かざんのふもとにせいそくする。５ほんのツノからほのおをだしておそってきたてきをげきたいする。

key: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
en: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
ja: たたかいになると６まいのハネからひのこのりんぷんをまきちらしてあたりいちめんをひのうみにする。

key: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
en: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
ja: はがねの体とこころをもつ。にらみつけるだけできょうぼうなポケモンもしたがわせてしまう。

key: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
en: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
ja: きょだいなじょうへきを一撃でとっぱするほどのとっしんりょく。でんせつでかたられるポケモン。

key: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
en: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
ja: 頭のツノはするどいやいば。つむじ風のようなうごきでてきをほんろうして素早くきりつける。

key: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
en: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
ja: トルネロスのしっぽからふきだしたエネルギーがおおあらしをおこす。みんかをふき飛ばすパワー。

key: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova Region firing off lightning bolts.
en: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova Region firing off lightning bolts.
ja: しっぽのトゲからでんげきをうちだす。イッシュちほうのそらをとび周りカミナリをおとす。

key: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.
en: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.
ja: レシラムのしっぽがもえるとねつエネルギーでたいきがうごいてせかいの天気が変化する。

key: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
en: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
ja: ひとがただしいこころをなくすとはげしいいかずちをおとしくにをほろぼすとしんわにえがかれた。

key: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.
en: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.
ja: 風やかみなりをとりこみかえたエネルギーがつちにえいようをあたえてだいちをゆたかにする。

key: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
en: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
ja: きょうりょくなれいとうエネルギーをたいないでつくりだすがもれだしたれいきで体がこおっている。

key: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
en: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
ja: うみやかわなどすいめんをはしりせかいじゅうをかけめぐっている。うつくしいみずべにあらわれる。

key: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
en: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
ja: メロエッタのかなでるせんりつは周りのポケモンをよろこばせたりかなしませるほどのパワーがある。

key: This ancient Bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
en: This ancient Bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
ja: プラズマだんによってかいぞうされたこだいのむしポケモン。せなかのたいほうがパワーアップした。

key: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
en: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
ja: ふだんやわらかい頭のトゲは力をこめるとするどくとがりいわをもつらぬくほどかたくなる。

key: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.
en: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.
ja: なかまどうしで体をぶつけあいあしこしをきたえる。自分からはたたかわないやさしいせいかく。

key: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
en: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
ja: かおのまえでこぶしをあわせて防御のポーズをとるとばくだんのちょくげきもたえる。

key: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
en: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
ja: こえだをもちあるきおやつがわりにポリポリたべる。みみからねっきをふきだして相手をいかくする。

key: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
en: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
ja: きのえだをしっぽからひきぬくときまさつでちゃっか。えだのほのおをふってなかまにあいずをおくる。

key: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
en: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
ja: つえのせんたんでもえるほのおをみつめてせいしんとういつするとみらいのできごとをみとおせる。

key: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
en: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
ja: せんさいなあわで体をつつみはだを守る。のんきにみせかけてぬけめなくしゅういをうかがう。

key: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
ja: あわでつつんだこいしをなげるわざを使う。３０メートルさきのあきかんにあてるコントロール。

key: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
en: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
ja: にんじゃのようにしんしゅつきぼつ。すばやいうごきでほんろうしつつみずのしゅりけんできりさく。

key: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
en: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
ja: シャベルのようなみみをもつ。あなほりできたえたみみはふといねっこをたちきる威力だ。

key: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it has finished digging, it lounges lazily.
en: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it has finished digging, it lounges lazily.
ja: おなかのたいもうはほおんせいにすぐれる。むかしのひとはぬけたたいもうでぼうかんぎをつくった。

key: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
en: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
ja: ひとなつっこいせいかく。うつくしいさえずりとおばねをふるうごきでなかまにあいずをおくる。

key: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
en: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
ja: おなかのほのおぶくろのかりょくがつよまるほど速くとべるがてんかするまで時間がかかる。

key: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
en: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
ja: はげしいたたかいでこうふんするとぜんしんのうもうのすきまからひのこをふきだしてひこうする。

key: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
en: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
ja: 体をおおうこながたいおんをちょうせつするのでどんなきこうやふうどのちいきでもくらせる。

key: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
en: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
ja: しげみのかげにかくれてくらす。てきにおそわれると体のけをするどくさかだてていかくする。

key: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
en: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
ja: せかいにはさまざまなはねもようのビビヨンがいる。すんでいるとちのきこうがえいきょうしているようだ。

key: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.
en: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.
ja: 強くなるためむれをはなれて１ぴきでせいかつするようになる。けっきさかんでけんかっぱやい。

key: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.
en: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.
ja: せっし６０００どのいきをはきだしはげしく相手をいかくする。メスがむれのこどもを守る。

key: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.
en: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.
ja: きにいったはなをみつけるといっしょうそのはなとくらす。風にのってきままにただよう。

key: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the power of flowers to battle.
en: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the power of flowers to battle.
ja: 自分のパワーをはなにあたえこころをこめてせわをする。かだんをあらすものはゆるさない。

key: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
en: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
ja: テリトリーはみごとなはなぞの。くさばながはなつエネルギーをあびて自分のパワーにするのだ。

key: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
ja: ひととくらすようになったさいしょのポケモンといわれる。おだやかなせいかくのポケモン。

key: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
en: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
ja: さんがくちたいでせいかつする。ツノをぶつけあう力くらべのしょうしゃがむれのリーダーだ。

key: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
en: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
ja: てきになめられないようがんばってにらみつけるが効果はうすい。くわえたはっぱがトレードマーク。

key: It charges ahead and bashes opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap telephone poles.
en: It charges ahead and bashes opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap telephone poles.
ja: こぶしでかたるタイプ。ガタガタいわずぶんなぐりダンプカーもふっ飛ばすとっしんをかます。

key: Historically, in the Kalos Region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
en: Historically, in the Kalos Region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
ja: おおむかしのカロスちほうではおうさまをごえいするやくめをあたえられたポケモン。

key: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
en: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
ja: １００メートルいないのものをふき飛ばすほどのサイコパワーをうまくコントロールできないのだ。

key: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.
en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.
ja: オスはぼうえいほんのうが強く自分やパートナーを守るときに最大きゅうのパワーをだす。

key: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
ja: ししゃのたましいがこだいのつるぎにやどってうまれたらしい。ひとにとりつきいのちをすう。

key: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
en: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
ja: ２ほんのつるぎによるふくざつなれんぞく攻撃を防ぐことはけんのたつじんでもふかのうだ。

key: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whomever it recognizes is destined to become king.
en: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whomever it recognizes is destined to become king.
ja: きょうりょくなれ威力でひとやポケモンをあやつりギルガルドにつごうのよいくにをつくらせた。

key: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.
en: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.
ja: むかしのきふじんたちはこうすいのかわりにこのみのかおりをだすシュシュプをつれていた。

key: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.
en: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.
ja: においがつよすぎるためよほどすきなトレーナーでなければつれてあるくのはキツイのだ。

key: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.
en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.
ja: ふわふわのたいもうはわた雨のようにあまいにおい。べたつくいとをだしててきをからめとる。

key: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human's. Even the faintest scent tells it about everything around. It can see with its nose.
en: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human's. Even the faintest scent tells it about everything around. It can see with its nose.
ja: たいもうにたくさんくうきをふくんでいるのでさわりごこちはやわらかくみためよりかるい。

key: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.
en: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.
ja: 光のてんめつでおそってきたてきのせんいをなくしてしまう。そのすきに姿をかくすのだ。

key: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.
en: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.
ja: さいみんじゅつでおびきよせて頭のしょくしゅでからめとりしょうかえきをあびせてしとめる。

key: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
ja: ２ひきのカメテテがひとつのいわでくらす。ケンカするとどちらかが他のいわにうつる。

key: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.
en: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.
ja: てあしにものうがありかってにうごけるがふだんは頭のガメノデスのめいれいにしたがう。

key: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
en: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
ja: くさったかいそうにぎたいする。きづかずにちかよってきたえものにどくえきをあびせてしとめる。

key: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.
en: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.
ja: ドラミドロがすむかいいきにまよいこんだふねは２どといきてもどれないといわれている。

key: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
en: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
ja: おおきなハサミからあっしゅくしたみずをピストルのようにうちだし飛んでいるえものをうちおとす。

key: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
en: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
ja: みずのほうだんをはっしゃするきょだいなハサミをもつ。タンカーのせんたいをうちぬくぞ。

key: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
ja: さばくでせいかつする。たいようの光をあびてはつでんすればエサをたべなくてもへいきなのだ。

key: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
ja: エリマキをひろげてはつでんする。エレザード１ぴきでこうそうビルで必要なでんきをつくれるのだ。

key: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.
en: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.
ja: じどうしゃをバリバリとかじってこわすおおあごのはか威力。１おくねんまえにせいそくしていた。

key: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.
en: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.
ja: １おくねんまえのせかいではむてきをほこりおうさまのようにふるまっていたポケモンだ。

key: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
en: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
ja: １おくねんまえからこおりづけになっていた体のいちぶからふっかつしたこだいのポケモン。

key: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
en: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
ja: マイナス１５０どのれいきをひしがたのけっしょうからだしててきをつつみこおりづけにする。

key: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer's arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer's feelings.
en: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer's arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer's feelings.
ja: トレーナーのうでにリボンじょうのしょっかくをまきつけてくる。ふれるときもちがわかる体。

key: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
en: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
ja: たいかくはこがらだがカイリキーやハリテヤマなどおおきなポケモンとごかくに戦うテクニシャン。

key: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.
en: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.
ja: しっぽではつでんしょやみんかのコンセントからでんきをすいとりヒゲからでんげきをうちだす。

key: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It is occasionally found during the excavation of caves.
en: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It is occasionally found during the excavation of caves.
ja: 体のほうせきがくもらないようメレシーのむれではふわふわのヒゲでおたがいをみがきあうのだ。

key: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.
en: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.
ja: いちばん弱いドラゴンポケモン。ヌメヌメの体がかわかないようジメジメしたひかげでくらす。

key: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.
en: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.
ja: なんでもとかしてしまうねんえきをぶんぴつしててきをげきたいする。めだまはたいかしてみえていない。

key: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
en: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
ja: ひとなつっこいドラゴンポケモン。だいすきなトレーナーにだきついてねんえきでヌルヌルにしてしまう。

key: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.
en: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.
ja: きにいったカギは絶対にてばなさないのでぼうはんのためにきんこのカギをもたせるのだ。

key: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.
en: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.
ja: もりでさまよいしんだこどものたましいがきりかぶにやどりポケモンになったといわれている。

key: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
en: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
ja: 他のきぎをじざいにあやつる。もりをあらすにんげんはしぬまでもりからでられないようにするのだ。

key: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
ja: じょうぶつできないたましいをかぼちゃの体にいれている。ひぐれとともにうごきはじめる。

key: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
en: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
ja: かみのけのようなうででえものをしめつける。くるしむようすをみながらたのしそうにうたうのだ。

key: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
en: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
ja: 体をおおうこおりがてきの攻撃を防ぐ。わられてもれいきですぐにこおりをはる。

key: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
en: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
ja: こおりついた体はこうてつのようにかたい。たちふ下がるものをきょたいでおしつぶしいどうする。

key: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
en: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
ja: まっくらなどうくつでくらす。２０まんヘルツのちょうおんぱをおおきなみみからはっしゃする。

key: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.
en: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.
ja: みみからはっするちょうおんぱできょだいないわもふんさいする。くらやみにまぎれておそいかかる。

key: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
ja: えいえんのいのちをわけ与えるといわれている。じゅもくの姿で１０００ねん眠りふっかつする。

key: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
en: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
ja: じゅみょうがつきるときあらゆるいきもののいのちをすいつくしまゆの姿にもどるという。

key: It is hypothesized that it is monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
en: It is hypothesized that it is monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
ja: せいたいけいをおびやかすものと戦うときさらにきょうりょくな姿に変化するといわれる。

key: Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.
en: Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off its enemies, but it's unable to maintain this body indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.
ja: するどいキバであっという間に敵をしとめるがこの体をながく保つことはできない。時がたつとくずれ落ちてしまう。

key: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.
en: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.
ja: 生態系をおびやかす者をあっとうてきな力でおさえこむときのジガルデのすがた。

key: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
en: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
ja: りょうてのすきまでくうきちゅうのたんそをあっしゅくしてたくさんのダイヤをいっしゅんでうみだす。

key: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
ja: くうかんをゆがめるリングであらゆるものをはなれた場所へとばしてしまうトラブルメーカー。

key: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
en: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
ja: せなかのアームからたいないのすいじょうきをふんしゃする。やまひとつふき飛ばす威力。

key: Silently it glides, drawing near its targets. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.
en: Silently it glides, drawing near its targets. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.
ja: いっさいおとをたてずかっくうしてきにきゅうせっきん。きづかぬまにきょうれつなけりをあびせる。

key: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
en: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
ja: きどりやでひまがあればつばさのていれ。うもうのよごれがきになりすぎてたたかえないことも。

key: Although basically cool and cautious, when it is caught by surprise, it is seized by panic.
en: Although basically cool and cautious, when it is caught by surprise, it is seized by panic.
ja: わずか０．１びょうでハネをつがえててきをうつ。まばたきのあいだにしょうぶがついている。

key: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.
en: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.
ja: かんじょうをださずひとりでいることをこのむ。しんらいをえるまでには時間がかかるぞ。

key: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
en: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
ja: くびのつけねにほのおのスズがある。ほのおがふきだすときリンリンとたかいおとがなる。

key: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it is not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.
en: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it is not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.
ja: とうそうしんにひがつくとこしの周りにあるほのおもひときわはげしくもえ上がる。

key: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It is famous for being a hard worker.
en: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It is famous for being a hard worker.
ja: だんりょくせいのあるみずのバルーンにのってだいジャンプ。アクロバティックに戦うぞ。

key: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.
en: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.
ja: なかまをおもうきもちが強い。トレーナーがおちこんでいるとダンスをおどってはげまそうとする。

key: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.
en: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.
ja: うたごえをいかし戦う。まいにちののどのメンテナンスはトレーナーのたいせつなやくめ。

key: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
en: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
ja: びょうかん１６れんだできをつつきあなをほる。あけたあなはエサをしまうちょぞうこやすに使う。

key: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
en: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
ja: クチバシをそりかえらせいろんなおとでなく。かなりうるさいので周りのおたくにはきらわれるぞ。

key: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.
en: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.
ja: たいないのガスをクチバシのなかで爆発させきのタネをはっしゃ。おおいわもこなごなにするパワー。

key: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.
en: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.
ja: エサをさがしうろつきつづける。ひがくれるころにはつかれはてたおれこむようにそのばで眠る。

key: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location, but it is always snoozing by nightfall.
en: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location, but it is always snoozing by nightfall.
ja: とてもがまんづよいせいしつだがこうぶつのコラッタをみつけるとわれをわすれてとびかかるぞ。

key: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
en: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
ja: じょうぶなアゴでじゅもくをけずりじゅえきをすする。ふだんはじめんのなかでくらす。

key: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
en: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
ja: たいないにちくでんきのうをもつ。キャンプのときなど１ぴきいるととてもありがたいポケモンだ。

key: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
en: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
ja: とびまわってスキをうかがう。でんきエネルギーをおおきなアゴでしゅうそくさせてきにはっしゃ。

key: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.
en: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.
ja: なぐりすぎでハサミはよくもげるがすぐにはえる。ハサミのなかみは少ないがコクがあってうまいぞ。

key: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
en: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
ja: とにかくみさかいなくなぐる。いざとなったらハサミをじせつしロケットのようにはっしゃしなぐる。

key: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
en: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
ja: はねをうちあわせてはっか。かれいなステップをふみながらはげしいほのおをあびせかけるぞ。

key: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.
en: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.
ja: 羽をこすりあわせて電気をおこす。おどるように敵へ近づき電撃のパンチをたたきこむ。

key: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.
en: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.
ja: ゆったりとゆれることで心をおちつかせる。高まったサイコパワーを敵にうちだすのだ。

key: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.
en: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.
ja: 夢見るようなおどりで死者をよびよせる。その悪意から力をえて敵をのろうのだ。

key: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
en: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
ja: はなににたオーラをもつひとの頭のうえにはたくさんのアブリーがあつまってくるよ。

key: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
en: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
ja: かふんをまるめだんごをつくる。しょくようから戦闘ようまでたくさんのしゅるいがあるよ。

key: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.
en: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.
ja: むかしからひととくらしてきた。トレーナーがかなしんでいるとそれをさっしてそばをはなれない。

key: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
en: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
ja: ちいさいころからしっかりそだてるとぜったいトレーナーをうらぎらないたのもしいあいぼうになる。

key: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.
en: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.
ja: 敵をおこらせてこうげきをさそい受けとめたあと岩のたてがみで頭突きをくらわせ骨をくだく。

key: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.
en: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.
ja: 夕日をあびてルガルガンは特別な進化をとげた。おだやかさの下にははげしい闘志がひそんでいる。

key: It is awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.
en: It is awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.
ja: ピンチになるとひとみをひからせなかまをよぶ。その光は４０キロメートルさきまでとどく。

key: At their appearance, even Gyarados will flee. When they team up to use Water Gun, its power exceeds that of Hydro Pump.
en: At their appearance, even Gyarados will flee. When they team up to use Water Gun, its power exceeds that of Hydro Pump.
ja: すがたを見せればギャラドスさえもにげだす。力をあわせてはなつみずでっぽうはハイドロポンプをこえる威力になる。

key: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
en: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
ja: 頭にあるどくトゲでえものをズブリ。よわったところを１０ぽんのしょくしゅでとらえとどめをさす。

key: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.
en: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.
ja: ドヒドイデのどくにやられると３か３ばんげきつうにくるしみたすかってもこういしょうがのこる。

key: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.
en: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.
ja: がんこでマイペースなせいかく。つちをはんでどろをつくってどろあそびするのがにっか。

key: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.
en: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.
ja: どろをまとったおもたいキックがとくい攻撃。おおがたトラックもかんたんにスクラップにするぞ。

key: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
en: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
ja: エサをもとめちじょうに上がる。すいほうをかぶるのはこきゅうとやわらかい頭を守るため。

key: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds weak, vulnerable Pokémon, it protects them and brings them into its water bubble.
en: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds weak, vulnerable Pokémon, it protects them and brings them into its water bubble.
ja: だいじなものをすいほうにしまうしゅうせいがある。ちゅういしないとトレーナーもしまおうとしてくるぞ。

key: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
en: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
ja: ひるまは光をあびて眠りよるになるとよりあんぜんなねどこをさがしあるきだす。

key: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis' vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
en: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis' vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
ja: まいをまうようにてきをきりさく。みやびな姿からもっともあでやかなくさポケモンとよばれる。

key: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
en: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
ja: てんめつしながらひかるほうしをあたりにばらまく。その光をみたものはふかい眠りにおちる。

key: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
en: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
ja: よなかにマシェードのすむもりにいくのはきけん。あやしい光にまどわされにどとかえれなくなる。

key: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
en: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
ja: たいえきをもやしどくガスをたく。ガスをすったてきがフラフラになったあとおそいかかるのだ。

key: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted for use in the production of luscious perfumes.
en: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted for use in the production of luscious perfumes.
ja: エサがとれなかったヤトウモリをほのおがふきだすてのひらではげしくビンタしおしおきする。

key: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.
en: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.
ja: だきしめられたりさわられるのがだいきらい。ジタバタあばれてていこうする力はものすごい。

key: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.
en: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.
ja: なかまとだきしめあうくせがある。その力でせぼねをくだかれてよをさるトレーナーも多い。

key: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
en: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
ja: おいしそうなかおりが体からもれだしている。においにさそわれたドデカバシにまるのみにされる。

key: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.
en: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.
ja: いつもげんきにとびはねている。げんきな姿といいかおりで周りにポケモンがあつまってくる。

key: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show, but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
en: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show, but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
ja: あしをいかしたけりがとくい。たおした相手をあしげにしてたかわらいでしょうりをアピール。

key: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.
en: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.
ja: ツルについたはなをうかべたおふろはリラックス効果がありおおくのじょせいにだいにんき。

key: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.
en: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.
ja: ジャングルおくちのきのうえにすむ。まれにうみべにあらわれてヤドキングとちえくらべをする。

key: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-- they will never let down a comrade.
en: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-- they will never let down a comrade.
ja: ２０ぴきぜんごのグループをつくる。そのけっそくはひじょうにかたくぜったいなかまをみすてない。

key: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
en: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
ja: おくびょうでたくさんのあしをばたつかせひっしににげまわる。にげたあとはピカピカきれい。

key: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater, or even air, right in two.
en: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater, or even air, right in two.
ja: するどくきょだいなツメでいっせん。くうきやかいすいさえいっとうりょうだんのうでまえ。

key: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.
en: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.
ja: くちのなかにてをいれたものをあやつってしまう。すなやまの体を大きくさせるためだ。

key: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
en: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
ja: しろのしたにはせいきをすわれひからびたものたちのホネがたいりょうにうまっている。

key: These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucus that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!
en: These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucus that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!
ja: ぜんしんたいえきでヌルヌル。うっかりふむところんでしまうしおこってなぐってくるぞ。

key: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.
en: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.
ja: じんこうのポケモン。ぼうそうのきけんがあるためせいぎょマスクで力をふういんされている。

key: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
en: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
ja: パートナーとのしんらいでかくせい。じざいにタイプをチェンジする能力をはっきし戦う。

key: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It is possible that it may survive if it is put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.
en: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It is possible that it may survive if it is put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.
ja: がいかくはとてもがんじょうだがちじょうにらっかするショックでこっぱみじんにくだけてしまう。

key: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
en: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
ja: ねたままうまれねたまましぬ。全ての行動はみているゆめによるねぞうらしい。

key: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
en: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
ja: せなかのこうらは爆発ぶつ。うっかりなぐればだい爆発。おなかのあながじゃくてん。

key: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
en: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
ja: せなかのハリのけはふだんはねている。こうふんするとさかだちおそってくるてきをつきさすのだ。

key: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
en: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
ja: しょうたいふめい。ボロきれのなかみをみたとあるがくしゃはきょうふのあまりショックしした。

key: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds it to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.
en: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds it to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.
ja: ヒドイデのハリもとおさないほどぶあついひふ。じょうぶなはでボリボリとハリをかじってくう。

key: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.
en: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.
ja: ひとなつっこくこどもがだいすき。なかよしのこどもとあそぶためにやまおくからまちにおりてくる。

key: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
en: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
ja: でかいイカリをブンブンふりまわしホエルオーさえ一撃でＫＯ。みどりのモズクがほんたいだ。

key: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
en: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
ja: ウロコをたたききもちをつたえる。ジャラコのすむこうざんではきんぞくおんがこだまする。

key: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
en: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
ja: おたけびとともにえものにとびかかる。ウロコのパンチは相手をズタズタにひきさくぞ。

key: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
en: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
ja: てきをみるとしっぽのウロコをジャラジャラならしていかく。弱いものはあわててにげだす。

key: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.
en: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.
ja: めにもとまらぬスピードでてきをかくらんする。ひどくおこりっぽいがなんでおこったかはすぐわすれる。

key: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.
en: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.
ja: ヒラヒラとび周りふしぎにひかるりんぷんをふりまく。ふれたものはたちまちげんきをとりもどすという。

key: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
en: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
ja: たいぼくをひきぬきブンブンふりまわす。くさきをしげらせてそのエネルギーをきゅうしゅうする。

key: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
en: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
ja: ふかいきりでてきをまどわせじめつさせるおそろしさをもつ。かいりゅうがエネルギーのみなもと。

key: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It is said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.
en: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It is said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.
ja: このせかいのポケモンかはなぞ。ピンチになるとワープをつかってあんぜんな場所へみをかくす。

key: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
en: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
ja: しんだようにまったくうごかないがふれるとほのかにあたたかい。おおむかしはほしのマユとよばれた。

key: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.
en: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.
ja: コスモッグがしんかした♂だといわれる。だい３のめがうかぶときべつせかいへとかけぬけていく。

key: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
en: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
ja: コスモッグがしんかした♀だといわれる。だい３のめがうかぶときべつせかいへととびさっていく。

key: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
en: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
ja: なぞにつつまれたＵＢのいっしゅ。まちゆくひとがきせいされあばれだす姿がもくげきされた。

key: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
en: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
ja: べつせかいからあらわれたＵＢ。みずからの体をみせつけてくるがじまんなのかいかくなのかふめい。

key: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.
en: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.
ja: ＵＢのいっしゅ。このせかいのものにけがれをかんじるのかいっさいてをふれようとしない。

key: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
en: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
ja: ぜんしんからすさまじいでんげきをほとばしらせるこうけいをもくげき。なぞのせいぶつＵＢのいっしゅだ。

key: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
en: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
ja: ＵＢのいっしゅ。２ほんのうでからガスをふきだしもりをやきはらう姿がかくにんされている。

key: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.
en: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.
ja: きょだいなてっとうをいっとうのもとにきりすてる姿がもくげきされたビーストのいっしゅ。

key: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.
en: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.
ja: きけんせいぶつビーストのいっしゅ。つねになにかをくらっているようだがなぜかフンはみはっけん。

key: Light is the source of its energy. If it is not devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
en: Light is the source of its energy. If it is not devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
ja: 光がエネルギーげん。光をくらわないでいるとふじゅんぶつがたまりくろずんでうごけなくなる。

key: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.
en: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.
ja: ソルガレオの光をむさぼっているすがた。敵にとびかかり四肢と背中のツメで切りさく。

key: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.
en: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.
ja: ルナアーラの光をむさぼっているすがた。巨大なツメで敵をつかみ力ずくで引きさく。

key: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.
en: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.
ja: 全身からあふれだす光は生きものにも自然にもさまざまなえいきょうをあたえる。

key: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
en: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
ja: きかいじかけの体はただのうつわ。ソウルハートとよばれるじんぞうのたましいがほんたい。

key: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
en: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
ja: かげのなかにひそむことができひとまえに姿をみせないのでそのそんざいはまぼろしだった。

key: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
en: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
ja: いせかいにすむウルトラビースト。頭のどくばりからどくえきを相手にかけてケラケラわらう。

key: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
en: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
ja: ウルトラビーストのいっしゅ。どくばりからねんどがたかくひかるどくえきをはっしゃする。

key: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
ja: ウルトラホールからしゅつげんした。ふくすうのせいめいがつみあがり１ぴきをけいせいしているようだ。

key: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It is apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It is apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
ja: ウルトラホールからあらわれたＵＢ。爆発で相手をおどろかしそのすきにせいきをうばっていた。

key: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
ja: りょうてあしのツメをたいでんさせ相手をやつざき。かわされてもとびちるでんげきでかんでんさせる。
